entries.design: A humble, modest peasant and common-folk wax seal, simple ochre brown natural beeswax with a slightly clumsy thick rim, one deeply pressed upright ear of grain with two small leaves. Only one modest symbol, no heraldic shield, crown, animal or elaborate decoration.
entries.referenceNote: Reference 1 provides the wax disc construction and irregular rim only. Replace all existing goats and knot ornament with the single ear of grain specified here. Reference 2 is the inventory illustration style only; no weapon or dragon emblem.

entries.design: A respectable middle-class citizen wax seal in muted brick red sealing wax. A neat circular impressed border enclosing one broad simple symmetrical interlaced two-loop knot, modest geometric private sign, no letters, no initials, no crown, no shield, no coat of arms. Slightly more carefully pressed and finished than a rustic seal.
entries.referenceNote: Reference 1 provides the wax disc construction and material only. Replace all goats and decorations with the simple two-loop knot specified here. Reference 2 is the inventory illustration style only; no weapon or dragon emblem.

No helmet, shield silhouette, crown, laurel branches or ribbon; simplify to the authentic feather.

The authentic sun and horizon are the only central emblem.
